name: Motion as Focus
job: Move the focal object or section transition; keep reading surfaces calmer
mechanism: transform/opacity; bounded canvas/media; section-owned choreography
reduced_motion: Reduced motion keeps composition and content; remove nonessential drift

name: Bounded Immersive Stage
job: Mount high-cost immersive work only inside signature section
mechanism: lazy mount; pause offscreen; clear entry/exit
reduced_motion: Static or lightweight branded fallback

name: Developer Proof Transition
job: Animate code/product state change to explain capability
mechanism: short state transition; cursor/event/output progression
reduced_motion: Show final state without motion

name: Cinematic Media Reveal
job: Use full-bleed media reveal for major world chapters
mechanism: poster -> user playback; chapter crossfade/scale
reduced_motion: Poster and copy remain complete without playback

name: Cinematic Chapter Reset
job: Use contrast between moving and still chapters to reset attention
mechanism: quiet -> media -> quiet rhythm
reduced_motion: Remove decorative interstitial motion

name: Low-Motion Dense Feedback
job: Dense data surfaces need stable scanning
mechanism: hover/focus/selection/filter feedback only
reduced_motion: No decorative motion required

name: Smooth Scroll Lifecycle
job: Long marketing story uses smooth scroll as feel layer
mechanism: single engine; coordinate modal/scroll lock; stop when hidden
reduced_motion: Native scrolling under reduced motion

name: Sticky Capability State Change
job: Stable proof shell changes state as capability copy advances
mechanism: sticky stage + bounded state transition
reduced_motion: Release sticky and stack states on mobile/reduced contexts

name: Sticky Local Rail
job: Keep local category/context visible through long section
mechanism: sticky rail with active state; independent from global nav
reduced_motion: Normal flow/accordion on narrow screens

name: Portfolio Stage Hold
job: Hold project visual/context while narrative advances
mechanism: sticky project media or chapter; GSAP/Lenis optional
reduced_motion: Stack media before text with no pinning

name: Bounded Drag Playground
job: Use drag/cursor interaction as optional expressive play
mechanism: Draggable within viewport boundary; inertia only when safe
reduced_motion: Static collage with identical content

name: Ambient Media Loop Zone
job: Add polish in limited identity zones
mechanism: muted loop video in hero/footer; lazy loading
reduced_motion: Still image with same crop/contrast

name: Lightweight Cinematic Still Motion
job: Give still artwork depth without 3D renderer
mechanism: subtle scale/crop/parallax; HUD transition; sticky deck
reduced_motion: Static authored crop keeps world identity

name: Weighted Scroll Timeline
job: Narrative beats deserve unequal dwell
mechanism: chapter weights -> normalized bounds -> hold/transform windows
reduced_motion: Linear chapter advance with no decorative interpolation

name: Sparse Event Peak
job: Reserve high-energy events for major story thresholds
mechanism: flash/FOV/bloom/shock/audio synchronized to central progress
reduced_motion: Skip peak FX; retain semantic chapter change

name: Pointer World Response
job: Pointer should affect material/world relationship
mechanism: smoothed pointer -> camera/world-space force; tap shock separated from drag
reduced_motion: Disable pointer force and keep scroll story

name: Operational Micro-Scene Animation
job: Automation claims need visible causal sequence
mechanism: status change -> handoff -> output; short loop or step state
reduced_motion: Static before/after or numbered sequence

name: Ticker/Carousel as Support
job: Logo/news/project streams can support rhythm without becoming core proof
mechanism: slow bounded ticker/carousel with controls where needed
reduced_motion: Static grid/list preserves access and content

name: Lightweight Illustrated Scroll World
job: make a portfolio world feel alive without continuous canvas rendering
mechanism: DOM/illustration entrances, bounded scroll-linked transforms, category state changes and final static poses
reduced_motion: show final illustration/state directly and remove walk/float/continuous drift

name: Collection Card Flip
job: reward project exploration while keeping the collection scannable
mechanism: front/back card state on hover/focus/tap with direct link to detail
reduced_motion: instant state change or always-visible critical metadata; no 3D flip required

name: Poster-First Media Reset
job: reset visual rhythm with cinematic media without requiring active playback
mechanism: poster/still owns first paint; video deferred with preload none; playback explicit if meaningful
reduced_motion: retain poster and copy; no playback required

name: Pinned Horizontal Sector Survey
job: turn vertical progress into a bounded spatial survey without losing narrative context
mechanism: single sticky viewport + wide horizontal track + explicit start/end + summary; supporting local reveals remain restrained
reduced_motion: render the sector sequence as static/vertical content with all names, coordinates and descriptions preserved

name: Sticky Thesis Hero -> Flow
job: give desktop service/audience openings spatial emphasis without trapping mobile
mechanism: tall sticky thesis hero on wide screens; content scrolls into supporting narrative
reduced_motion: normal-flow hero with identical message and proof order

name: Sticky Release Date Rail
job: orient readers in a high-volume chronological changelog
mechanism: dates and small markers stick as users pass stacked update entries
reduced_motion: stable chronological sections and static labeled dates

name: Viewport-Triggered SaaS Proof Counter
job: transition numerical proof when supporting context enters view
mechanism: Framer scroll region triggers counter from 0%/0.0x placeholders toward final figures and may render duplicate animated nodes
reduced_motion: render final verified value and label immediately without number rolling or duplicated screen-reader announcements

name: Operational Mode Panel Swap
job: illustrate three modes without losing app context
mechanism: Agent and Thread buttons change read-only simulated pane and copy; precise easing unmeasured
reduced_motion: instant semantic panel updates; no autoplay needed

name: Bounded Editorial Media Stage
job: give agency identity a strong first impression without permanent animation
mechanism: site features reel video and image-led long-form editorial sections; exact scroll timeline and easing were not independently measured
reduced_motion: poster/static image plus meaningful text and CTA

name: Project Preview as Context Reveal
job: associate rich project imagery with identity/discipline before entering case
mechanism: hover-capable portfolio visuals combined with permanent project links and metadata; precise pointer animation not tested
reduced_motion: make project identity/action visible without hover or animation

name: Accessible 3D Sector Carousel
job: show six client/industry stories in a rich motion surface
mechanism: browser exposes 3D Carousel item-of-six semantics plus Previous/Next and arrow-key instructions; click did not conclusively prove current item changed
reduced_motion: flat ordered client list; keyboard/touch controls

name: Editorial Motion Showreel Boundary
job: reinforce studio work without looping video taking over navigation
mechanism: homepage showreel and one video node desktop, supported by framed stills and CTA; exact scroll easing not measured
reduced_motion: static poster with readable captions and related cases

name: Numeric Agency Recognition Strip
job: punctuate brand claim with short motion and dated achievement context
mechanism: homepage and about counters display rolling digits; source award metrics not independently authenticated
reduced_motion: show final meaningful source-attributed numbers without animation
